nodes.objective:
Implement TASK-0094 acceptance criteria. 1) Add a deterministic
cross-alignment validator in src/ahra/cross_alignment.py that
rejects drafts where any must, must_not, or completion_signal
boundary entry lacks a covering Claim criterionRefs reference, any
Claim references a free_zone entry, any required Claim lacks a
covering PlanNode claimRef, any PlanNode claimRef does not resolve
in the frozen ClaimGraph, or any open_question entry remains; cover
each failure class with a unit test in
tests/test_cross_alignment.py. 2) Wire the validator into the
src/ahra/alignment_session.py exit path ahead of
RequestDraftAdmission: on failure the RequestDraft is rejected
before Human Gate 2 with a structured mismatch report recorded in
the session snapshot, redraft attempts are bounded, and exhausting
the bound terminates the session with a recorded failure; cover
with tests/test_alignment_session.py. 3) Keep behavior consistent
with the cross-alignment gate row in
docs/architecture/intent-alignment-workflow.md. Run
uv run python -B scripts/check.py and record it in
WorkReport.verification_commands_run.
Loop-001 trace:
work/tasks/TASK-0094/runs/loop-001/artifacts/bounded-task-executor/tasks/task-0094/attempt-1/patch.diff
contains an implementation-shaped patch and deterministic-evidence.json
records uv run python -B scripts/check.py with exit_code 0, but
GEXEC-ee215e366a5767b2 timed out before review/kernel evidence. Reuse
only the correct implementation shape, rerun verification, and ensure
the Workflow B Task reviewer returns a ReviewResult.criteria item whose
criterion field is exactly CLM-TASK-0094.
Verify the cross-alignment validator, fail-closed rejection, and bounded redraft loop are present and consistent.

spec.rationale:
Workflow A v2, step 3 of 3 (ADR-0010). Per work/tasks/TASK-0094/task.md:
a deterministic cross-alignment validator must run in the alignment
session exit path ahead of RequestDraftAdmission, fail closed with a
structured mismatch report, and bound redraft attempts. Depends on
TASK-0092 boundary contract and TASK-0093 serial drafting. Declared
filesystem.write resources are the request-scoped allowlist. Loop-001
produced a patch and passed uv run python -B scripts/check.py, but the
GoalExecution timed out before semantic review and kernel evidence; use
loop-001 only as trace input and produce fresh loop-002 evidence.
